result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major visual obstruction from a stuck/misplaced loading spinner, and a minor clipped content issue in the restaurant carousel.

issues.description: A loading spinner overlays the Tokumaru Ramen Bar restaurant image, obscuring content and suggesting either a stuck loading state or a misplaced UI element that fails to clear after content loads.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the spinner only appears during active content loading and is automatically hidden once content is fully rendered. Adjust z-index/positioning to prevent it from overlapping completed content.

issues.description: The full title of the 'Trattoria Piccolo' restaurant card is clipped by the right screen edge in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, making the complete name unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Modify the card sizing or carousel layout to fit the full restaurant title within the card bounds, or enable text wrapping for long titles while preserving the layout's clean appearance.
